title: 第21章 病秧子竟抢她吃的第22章 沈栖尘
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第21章病秧子竟抢她吃的回想过去，她的剑势愈发凌厉。
林霆挨了几剑后，终于有机会拔剑，但发现自己依旧应付得吃力。
他心中惊骇又屈辱。
明明都是炼气期，他竟然不是云洛对手。
这不可能，他可是上品灵根。
云洛在他身上大大小小划拉了二十多道口子，感觉心里舒服了，才神清气爽地收招。
别说她用的是《惊鸿》，就林霆这花架子，她用普通剑招，对方也不一定是对手。
“再敢来犯贱，见一次我打一次。”
她帅气地收剑，翻身爬上拽拽的背。
林霆看到拽拽，不知想到什么，眼中露出一丝轻蔑。
“看来合欢宗对你也不怎么样，连只像样的灵宠都没有。”
“云洛，这人啊，还是要看出身。没有人扶持，你再努力一辈子也就止步于金丹了。”
“本少爷愿意再给你一次机会，只要你你答应当我的炉鼎，天阶灵植、灵器丹药……”
“阿嚏！”
拽拽猛地打了个喷嚏，鼻涕口水喷了林霆一脸。
它用爪子划拉一下地面的沙土，十分不耐烦道：
“主人，这人叽里呱啦说什么呢？”
云洛拍拍它脑袋：
“听不懂，应该不是人话，不必理会，我们走。”
说罢，拽拽四条矮胖的腿奔跑起来，甩了林霆一脸尘土，不给他反唇相讥的机会。

林霆又怒又恼，还有些惊愕。
没记错的话，云洛那兔狲不过是一只凡兽，短短三年，如今竟能口吐人语。
这需要投喂多少灵丹妙药？
刚刚自己还嘲讽合欢宗对她一般，连只像样的灵宠都没有。
想到这，林霆脸上火辣辣的。
他将拳头捏得咯咯作响，目光阴鸷地看向云洛离开的方向。
“等进了秘境，定要你跪下来求饶！”
……
云洛回到合欢宗休息的地方时，远远看到有两位男修在青蘅长老面前大打出手。
她忙跑过去，蹲在一大石头后面，手指覆在手链的铃铛处。
万一两人没控制好切磋强度，她也好及时开保护罩。
“你算什么东西？”
“我不是东西，我是她的狗！”
“你……我是她的小猫咪，喵～”
“呕～”
“……”
云洛看得津津有味，最喜欢看男人扯头花了。
正看得入神，头顶突然投下阴影。
青蘅盯着她：“好看吗？”
content_en:
Chapter 21 Bingyangzi actually robbed her of food. Looking back on the past, her sword power became even more fierce.
After Lin Ting took a few blows, he finally had the chance to draw his sword, but found that he was still struggling to cope.
He was horrified and humiliated.
It was obviously the Qi refining period, but he was no match for Yun Luo.
This is impossible, he has a high-grade spiritual root.
Yun Luo made more than 20 large and small cuts on his body. He felt comfortable, and then he stopped feeling refreshed.
Not to mention she was using "Jinghong", even if Lin Ting was so showy, if she used ordinary sword moves, the opponent might not be her opponent.
"If you dare to do something mean again, I'll beat you every time you see me."
She sheathed her sword handsomely, turned over and climbed onto Yanlao's back.
When Lin Ting saw Tutu, he didn't know what he thought of, and there was a trace of contempt in his eyes.
"It seems that the Hehuan Sect doesn't treat you very well. It doesn't even have a decent spiritual pet."
"Yunluo, you still have to look at your origins. Without anyone to support you, no matter how hard you work your whole life, you will stop at the golden elixir."
"This young master is willing to give you another chance, as long as you agree to be my cauldron, heaven-level spiritual plants, spiritual weapons and elixirs..."
"Ah sneeze!"
Tutu sneezed suddenly, spraying snot and saliva all over Lin Ting's face.
It scratched the sand on the ground with its paws and said impatiently:
"Master, what is this man talking about?"
Yunluo patted its head:
"I don't understand. It's probably not human language. Don't pay attention. Let's go."
After that, he pulled his four short and fat legs and ran, throwing dust on Lin Ting's face and not giving him a chance to retort.
Lin Ting was angry, annoyed, and a little shocked.
If I remember correctly, Yunluo was just an ordinary beast. In just three years, he could now speak human language.
How much magic elixir does this need to be fed?
Just now, she had ridiculed the Hehuan Sect for treating her so poorly and not even having a decent spiritual pet.
Thinking of this, Lin Ting's face burned.
He clenched his fists loudly and looked sinisterly in the direction Yun Luo left.
"When you enter the secret realm, I will make you kneel down and beg for mercy!"
…
When Yun Luo returned to the resting place of Hehuan Sect, he saw two male cultivators fighting in front of Elder Qingheng from a distance.
She hurriedly ran over and squatted behind a large stone, her fingers covering the bell of the bracelet.
If the two of them failed to control the intensity of their sparring, she could open the protective cover in time.
"Who do you think you are?"
"I'm not a thing, I'm her dog!"
"You...I am her little kitten, meow~"
"Ugh~"
"..."
Yun Luo watched it with gusto, and he liked to watch men talking nonsense.
Just as he was watching intently, a shadow suddenly fell over his head.
Qing Heng stared at her: "Does it look good?"
